name: io.github.solsolettidev/nats-trail
description: Read-only NATS and JetStream observability: trace a request across streams, rank what is broken.

environmentVariables.name: NATS_TRAIL_API
environmentVariables.description: URL of the NATS Trail bridge, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4000. Without it the server answers only from local state and cannot reach JetStream.

environmentVariables.name: NATS_TRAIL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the bridge, required when it has auth enabled. A read-scoped token is enough: this server never mutates.
